nodes.label: AI chat via Expo Router API route (chat+api.ts) calling Claude
nodes.norm_label: ai chat via expo router api route (chat+api.ts) calling claude
nodes.rationale: Key stays on the server; no separate backend; opt-in consent, minimal context, no stored conversations.

nodes.label: Expo Router with native tabs and Stack.Protected
nodes.norm_label: expo router with native tabs and stack.protected

nodes.label: Community on Supabase (private schema, security-definer functions)
nodes.norm_label: community on supabase (private schema, security-definer functions)
nodes.rationale: Server-side authorization not bypassable by editing ids; anonymous auth; moderation built in; tested with PGlite.

nodes.label: Journey (points, challenges, memories, Your best)
nodes.rationale: Recomputed from logged events, no stored score, so nothing is double-counted and a cigarette never removes points; league compares only against own past weeks.

nodes.label: Pure domain functions in src/domain with Jest tests
nodes.norm_label: pure domain functions in src/domain with jest tests
nodes.rationale: Timer, money, streaks and badges are testable without UI and can move to a server unchanged.

nodes.label: ACT / Motivational interviewing / CBT relapse prevention content
nodes.norm_label: act / motivational interviewing / cbt relapse prevention content

nodes.label: Bridge to effective treatments (nudge-to-treatment funnel)
nodes.rationale: App features alone are tier 3-4; getting users onto medication and structured support makes the app a tier 1/2 intervention. iCanQuit: 40% vs 18% quit among NRT users.

nodes.label: zustand + persist to AsyncStorage (single JSON document)
nodes.norm_label: zustand + persist to asyncstorage (single json document)
nodes.rationale: Data small and single-user; a database would be overhead; versioned with a migrate hook. MMKV needs a dev build.

nodes.label: No shared leaderboard (yet)
nodes.rationale: Would need accounts and server-side event log, breaking the no-account promise; see docs/LEADERBOARD.md.

nodes.label: Offline-first, private-by-default requirement
nodes.rationale: No accounts, no payments; only opt-in AI chat touches a server; works with no internet.

nodes.label: Slip/badge/nudge no-shaming rules
nodes.rationale: Slip never erases past smoke-free days; badges need real behaviour; nudge only after 3+ days, at most weekly.

nodes.label: Caveats and compliance (no medical claims, clinician review)
nodes.norm_label: caveats and compliance (no medical claims, clinician review)
nodes.rationale: Standalone apps unproven (RR 1.00), so never claim the app helps you quit; dosing features risk medical-device classification; no shaming or fear-only messaging.

nodes.label: Roadmap (v1.1 widget, v2 backend, v3 AI coach, Promise Pot)
nodes.norm_label: roadmap (v1.1 widget, v2 backend, v3 ai coach, promise pot)

nodes.label: Continuous Native Generation
nodes.rationale: ios/ and android/ are generated; native behavior is configured via app.json and config plugins.

nodes.label: Development Build Requirement
nodes.rationale: Expo Go only bundles its own native modules.

nodes.label: EAS Build, Submit and Update
nodes.rationale: Cloud builds avoid needing local Xcode or Android Studio.

nodes.label: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY Setup
nodes.rationale: Never an EXPO_PUBLIC_ name, so the key is not bundled into the client.

nodes.label: Chat Cost and Rate Limits
nodes.rationale: In-memory per instance; should move to shared store before being a hard budget. No prompt caching because prompt is below minimum cacheable length.

nodes.label: Server Output and EAS Hosting Deployment
nodes.norm_label: server output and eas hosting deployment
nodes.rationale: web.output server is required for API routes; Anthropic SDK only in server bundle.

nodes.label: Supportive Companion System Prompt
nodes.rationale: Not a clinician: no diagnosis, prescribing or invented statistics.

nodes.label: hCaptcha Protection
nodes.rationale: Anonymous sign-ups are otherwise easy to automate.

nodes.label: Community Post and Reply Rate Limits
nodes.norm_label: community post and reply rate limits

nodes.label: Support Lines Verification
nodes.rationale: Numbers only added after checking official sources; record source and verifiedAt; re-check yearly.

nodes.label: Export and Delete All My Data
nodes.norm_label: export and delete all my data

nodes.label: Android Expo Go Notifications Disabled
nodes.rationale: Since SDK 53 expo-notifications throws in Android Expo Go.

nodes.label: Craving SOS
nodes.rationale: Based on the 4 D's, mindfulness and distraction approaches.

nodes.label: 30-second If-Then Plans
nodes.rationale: Implementation intentions meta-analysis (OR 1.70).

nodes.label: Next Cigarette Timer
nodes.rationale: Cutting down works as well as abrupt quitting (Cochrane 2019); wait grows 5/10/15% per week.

nodes.label: Readiness Nudge
nodes.rationale: Not ready does not mean won't quit; offered at most once a week.

nodes.label: Slip Rescue
nodes.rationale: Counters the abstinence-violation effect; slips never reset smoke-free days.

nodes.label: Three Modes (Just watch / Cut down / Quit now)
nodes.norm_label: three modes (just watch / cut down / quit now)
nodes.rationale: Most smokers are not ready to quit (CDC GATS 2015).

nodes.label: AI Support Chat
nodes.rationale: Opt-in; the only feature sending data off the phone, after consent.

nodes.label: Peer-support Community
nodes.rationale: Deliberately not a social network: no follower counts, likes leaderboard or engagement notifications.

nodes.label: Content Review Process
nodes.rationale: Nothing is clinically or natively reviewed yet; REVIEW in src/i18n/articles.ts must be updated before claiming review.

nodes.label: Shared Leaderboard Design (not built)
nodes.rationale: Not built on purpose; would require accounts and server storage; opt-in, small groups, category-based, never health data.

nodes.label: App Store Listing v1
nodes.rationale: Lists only features that exist in v1; Health & Fitness category.

nodes.label: FivehunCig Quit-Smoking App
nodes.rationale: Built for smokers not ready to set a quit date; starts where the user is.

nodes.label: Use expo install for Dependencies
nodes.rationale: Resolves SDK-compatible package versions.

nodes.label: Fetch Versioned Expo Docs Rule
nodes.rationale: Expo ships breaking changes every SDK release, so APIs must be checked against docs for the installed major version rather than memory.

nodes.label: Crisis Keyword Safety Detection
nodes.rationale: Runs on phone and server in EN/FR/AR so crisis messages never reach the model; deliberately broad, with system prompt as second line.

nodes.label: Chat Data Minimisation
nodes.rationale: Only last 12 turns and coarse numbers sent; conversations in memory only; logs are metrics, never text.

nodes.label: Capped Points for Supporting Others
nodes.rationale: Only replies supporting someone else earn 5 points, max 3/day; posting, reacting and time in app earn nothing.

nodes.label: Private Schema + Security Definer RPC
nodes.rationale: Tables hidden with forced RLS; app only calls public.community_* and mod_* functions that use auth.uid().

nodes.label: Reviewed Captioned Video Policy
nodes.rationale: videos.ts is empty on purpose; videosFor() only offers published, clinically reviewed, captioned videos; no placeholder or AI-generated health videos.

nodes.label: Server-authoritative Points from Raw Events
nodes.rationale: Server dedupes events, rejects implausible rates and recomputes points; a client-set points endpoint must never exist.

nodes.label: Expo SDK 57 + React Native 0.86 + TypeScript
nodes.rationale: One codebase; Expo Go on-device testing; EAS builds iOS without a Mac (dev machine is Windows).

nodes.label: JS-driven RTL (native RTL off)
nodes.rationale: Native RTL disabled in Expo Go on SDK 57 and needs reloadAsync; JS direction switches instantly. Trade-off: native chrome stays LTR.

nodes.label: Security and privacy (no analytics, validate.ts, export/delete)
nodes.norm_label: security and privacy (no analytics, validate.ts, export/delete)

nodes.label: expo-audio local synthesized sounds
nodes.rationale: Pattern Pop notes add working-memory load; no video in SOS because active tasks beat passive watching; expo-speech rejected because sound differs by device.

nodes.label: Typed i18n dictionaries EN/FR/AR (src/i18n)
nodes.rationale: Compile-time check of missing strings and parameters; hand-written CLDR plural rules because Hermes lacks Intl.PluralRules everywhere.

nodes.label: SOS activities ordered by acute-craving evidence
nodes.norm_label: sos activities ordered by acute-craving evidence

nodes.label: Brisk walking / acute exercise for cravings
nodes.norm_label: brisk walking / acute exercise for cravings

nodes.label: Voice playback integration (Voice switch, silent mode)
nodes.norm_label: voice playback integration (voice switch, silent mode)

nodes.label: Cross-cutting measurement (personal what-works-for-me engine)
nodes.rationale: Pre/post 0-10 craving rating plus a 30-minute follow-up notification, stored on-device, ranks tools by personal average drop; offline, private, adaptive.

nodes.label: Elaborated-intrusion theory (working-memory competition)
nodes.rationale: Tasks that load visuospatial working memory compete with craving imagery; justifies Memory match, Block Drop, Vivid Escape and the Pattern Pop rework.

nodes.label: Arabic MSA vs Tunisian Darija choice
nodes.norm_label: arabic msa vs tunisian darija choice
nodes.rationale: MSA matches screen text for read-along; Tunisian is warmer but drafts need native-speaker review; one column must be used for every clip.

nodes.label: Recording guidelines
nodes.rationale: Calm, warm friend-like voice, never coach or doctor; consistent distance/volume; clips under max length so Breathe words fit inside 4-6 s breaths.

nodes.label: Safe video integration (link-out/official embeds)
nodes.rationale: Embeds respect publisher terms; never re-host YouTube files; cache only owned/licensed content; label distressing testimonials.
